title: [clinic · EX-08] Implement a new chunking strategy
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-08` — Implement a new chunking strategy](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-08-implement-a-new-chunking-strategy.md) · difficulty 🔴

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Not producing stable chunk ids, which quietly breaks the incremental path — see [ADR-0004](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/20-decisions/0004-stable-chunk-ids.md).

**2.** Dropping the heading path, which is what makes a retrieved chunk attributable and is why contextual chunking did not help here ([#37](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/discussions/37)).

**3.** Registering the strategy but not adding it to the bake-off, so nothing ever measures it.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-08]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
